thought.text: The full claim set is now present, including `groups: instance_admin`. Let me confirm the admin group claim selection:

reasoning_content:
Now the full set of claims is displayed, including `{"path":"groups","value":"instance_admin"}` and `{"path":"email","value":"kai@example.com"}`.

Next, POST to confirm the claim, setting `admin_group_claim_choice` = `{"path":"groups","value":"instance_admin"}`. This matches the e2e expectation ("operator selects the claim value 'instance_admin' as the admin group claim").

The form field name is `admin_group_claim_choice`, with the JSON value `{"path":"groups","value":"instance_admin"}`. The CSRF token is required.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
CSRF=$(cat sc_csrf.txt)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt \
  --data-urlencode "_csrf_token=$CSRF" \
  --data-urlencode 'admin_group_claim_choice={"path":"groups","value":"instance_admin"}' \
  -D confirm_h.txt -o confirm_body.html -w "confirm POST: [%{http_code}]\n" \
  "http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap/select-claim"
grep -i '^HTTP\|^location' confirm_h.txt
